subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Rights and responsibility
source.subtopic: Learners' rights and responsibilities; rights and responsibilities of others at home and at school

show.line: I have rights, like going to school. I have responsibilities, like doing homework!

rounds.prompt: Every child has the right to...?
I have the right to learn. So I must...?
Which is a responsibility at home?

rounds.story: Everyone has a right to play. Tumi lets the new boy join in. Is Tumi respecting his right?

rounds.prompt: Every child has the right to...?

hints: Rights are what we get. Responsibilities are what we do.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I have the right to learn.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: So I don't have to listen!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The right to learn means I listen.

parent_line: Can tell rights from responsibilities at home and school.
